y-m-61-03.material:
Chaza umsebenzi f ngama-constant a no-b kanje.
Ku-x<1, f(x)=x²+a, futhi ku-x≥1, f(x)=3x+b. (x² ifundwa 'x squared'. a no-b yizinombolo ezingakanqunywa.)
Cabanga ukuthi umsebenzi f uqhubeka ku-x=1. Okungukuthi, umkhawulo we-f(x) njengoba x isondela ku-1 ukhona futhi ulingana no-f(1).

y-m-61-10.topic: Imikhawulo yemisebenzi: imikhawulo yezingxenyana lapho isihlukanisi sisondela ku-0, nama-coefficient angakanqunywa
y-m-61-10.goal: Qonda umbandela inombolo engaphezulu okufanele iwulandele uma umkhawulo wengxenyana lapho isihlukanisi sisondela ku-0 uyinani elinqunyiwe, thola umugqa esixazululweni oxubanisa inani lomkhawulo nenani lenombolo engaphezulu, bese wakha wena (a, b) lapho inani lomkhawulo lingu-L.
y-m-61-10.material: Kuma-constant a no-b, cabanga ukuthi (x²+ax+b)/(x−1) isondela ku-3 njengoba x isondela ku-1. (x²+ax+b ithi 'x ngesikwele kwengeziwe a x kwengeziwe b', futhi isihlukanisi sithi 'x kususwe 1'.) UYunseo uzame ukuthola a no-b kanje.

y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.0: Njengoba x isondela ku-1, inani le-(x²+ax+b)/(x−1) lisondela ku-3.

y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.2: Ukufaka x=1 enombolweni engaphezulu kunika 1+a+b, ngakho 1+a+b=3.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.3: Khona-ke b=2−a, ngakho inombolo engaphezulu ngu-x²+ax+2−a.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.4: Hlola ukuthi lesi sibalo siyahlukaniseka nge-(x−1) ukuthola a.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uyaphutha. Umugqa 2 uthe inombolo engaphezulu isondela ku-0, ngakho 1+a+b kufanele ibe ngu-0. U-3 yinani lomkhawulo wengxenyana yonke, hhayi inani lenombolo engaphezulu. Emigqeni 4 no-5, umphumela wokubeka inombolo engaphezulu ibe ngu-3 isibalo esilingana no-3 ku-x=1 futhi esingahlukaniseki nge-(x−1).

y-m-61-10.s.s3.prompt: Qala unqume inani lomkhawulo u-L, bese uthola izinombolo eziphelele u-a no-b abanika leli nani lomkhawulo. Faka u-(a, b, L) abathathu abahlukile, abanama-L ahlukile, ukuze umkhawulo luka-(x²+ax+b)/(x−1) njengoba u-x esondela ku-1 ube ngu-L (inombolo ephelele engu-1≤L≤5).

y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c3: Inani lomkhawulo ngemuva kokucisha, u-a+2, lilingana no-L.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Inani lomkhawulo alisiso u-L. Bhala inombolo ephezulu njengomkhiqizo luka-(x−1) nesinye isisho somugqa, ucishe, futhi uthole inani lomkhawulo.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.explain: Uma u-1+a+b=0, bese u-b=−1−a no-x²+ax−1−a=(x−1)(x+1+a). Ukucisha kunika u-x+1+a, futhi umkhawulo njengoba u-x esondela ku-1 ngu-a+2. Ngakho u-L=a+2 no-b=−1−a, futhi u-(a, b) oyedwa unqunywa kuma-L ngamunye.
